settings.enabled_help: Turn Cloudflare API integration on or off.
settings.api_token_help: Create an API token in Cloudflare with Zone:Cache Purge and Zone:Read permissions.
settings.zone_id_help: The ID of the zone whose cache should be managed.
settings.zone_name_help: The domain name of the zone (for reference).
settings.auto_purge_help: Purge the Cloudflare cache automatically when discussions or posts are created.
settings.development_mode_help: Toggle Cloudflare development mode for the zone.
settings.bot_fight_mode_help: Enable Cloudflare Bot Fight Mode for the zone.
settings.always_online_help: Serve cached pages when the origin is unavailable.
settings.brotli_help: Enable Brotli compression for the zone.
settings.rocket_loader_help: Enable Rocket Loader for JavaScript resources.
settings.browser_cache_ttl_help: Set the browser cache TTL for the zone.
settings.ssl_mode_help: Set the SSL/TLS encryption mode for the zone.
settings.always_use_https_help: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS.
settings.min_tls_version_help: Set the minimum TLS version for the zone.
settings.automatic_https_rewrites_help: Automatically rewrite HTTP URLs to HTTPS.
settings.early_hints_help: Enable Early Hints (103) for the zone.
settings.opportunistic_encryption_help: Enable opportunistic encryption for the zone.
